style: Style: dark high-fantasy MMORPG art in the spirit of classic Korean MMOs from the 2000s - rich painterly rendering, dramatic lighting, deep shadows, gold and crimson accents, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no UI.

progress_frame.prompt: A single very long thin horizontal PROGRESS BAR FRAME for a fantasy MMORPG loading screen, classic MU Online style: dark burnished bronze and antique gold filigree metal frame with a small red gem ornament at each pointed end cap and a tiny ornament at top center; inside the frame a long, perfectly plain, flat, very dark empty recessed channel (no fill, no light) where the progress fill will be drawn. Perfectly left-right symmetric, orthographic flat front view. Extremely wide aspect ratio about 12:1, filling the canvas width. Isolated, no text.

loading_sigil.prompt: A single circular MAGIC SIGIL / rune circle for a fantasy MMORPG loading indicator, classic MU Online style: concentric rings of glowing golden runes and thin gold geometric lines with small red gem points, softly glowing amber light, perfectly radially symmetric so it can rotate, orthographic top-down flat view, transparent center. Isolated, no text or letters (runes are abstract glyph shapes). Square 1:1.
